trial_court: Family Court Bilaspur in Civil Suit No.208A/2017
case_name: Smt. Geeta Manikpuri vs Kamlesh Manikpuri
facts_of_case: Marriage between parties took place on 22.05.2002. Husband sought divorce due to cruelty and desertion. Wife filed appeal against divorce. Husband also appealed against order granting Rs.1 lakh under section 27 of Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: Mental cruelty can be inferred when a prosecution is launched against the husband on a complaint made by the wife, making serious allegations in which the husband and his family members are constrained to undergo trial, which ultimately ends with acquittal.
legal_principles.held: When a prosecution was launched against the husband on a complaint made by the wife u/s 498-A of IPC, making serious allegations in which the husband and his family members were constrained to undergo trial, which ultimately ended with acquittal, then in such a case, it cannot be accepted that no cruelty was meted out to the husband.
cited_cases: Rani Narasimha Sastry vs. Rani Suneela Rani, (2019) SCC OnLine SC 1595
use_in: divorce cases where prosecution is launched against the husband
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — one reason why: it highlights the importance of considering the impact of a criminal trial on the husband's mental well-being

legal_principles.principle: Mental cruelty can be inferred when a party cannot reasonably be expected to live with the other due to the conduct of the other party.
legal_principles.held: Mental cruelty must be of such a nature that the parties cannot reasonably be expected to live together. The situation must be such that the wronged party cannot reasonably asked to put up with such conduct and continue to live with the other party.
cited_cases: V. Bhagat v. D. Bhagat (Mrs.) (1994) 1 SCC 33
use_in: divorce cases where mental cruelty is alleged
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — one reason why: it provides a clear standard for determining whether mental cruelty has occurred

outcome.final_order: Divorce granted to the husband on ground of cruelty and desertion. Amount of Rs.1 lakh ordered under section 27 was confirmed.
